terms.subtitle: Please read before using the system.

blocks.text: Use your own account only and do not share your password.
A submitted form is final and cannot be edited.
Do not try to access data that is not yours.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: How your data is used and kept.

blocks.heading: What we record
blocks.text: This system records your name and contact details, your attendance, and the answers you submit in the daily forms, to run and evaluate the training program.

blocks.heading: Who sees it
blocks.text: Only the General Supervisor can see which answers are yours. Supervisors and trainers see no individual answers. Reports show combined results and never your name.

blocks.heading: How long we keep it
blocks.text: We keep your data until you ask us to delete it. On request, the General Supervisor removes your identity from the system: your name and contact details are erased and your login is disabled. Combined results and approved reports remain, because they do not identify you.

blocks.heading: Your requests
blocks.text: To access, correct or delete your data, write to {email}.
